verdict.rationale: The app has its own export: from Runs you can open a single run and use "Export trace" to export its screenshots, actions and saved annotations for analysis by another agent (gh-6). Runs are otherwise kept on the phone (docs-8). However, export works one run at a time, the trace's format is not stated to be open or documented, and nothing covers exporting other user data such as saved tasks or settings. Missing for 10: bulk export of all data, a documented open format for the trace, export of saved tasks and configuration, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the export.
